gbm_population_evidence.quote: According to Rano criteria, there are evaluable intracranial lesions, and recurrent high-grade gliomas have been confirmed.

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients with recurrent high-grade gliomas are being enrolled , treated with anlotinib 12mg once daily for 14 days every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients have undergone surgery and relapsed after receiving standard radiotherapy and chemotherapy;

role_evidence.quote: This is a phase II, open-label, single center study, aiming to investigate safety and efficacy of anlotinib in treatment of recurrent high-grade glioma.

agents.drug_class_hint: multi-target receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGFR/FGFR/PDGFR/c-Kit), approved in China only
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Anlotinib hydrochloride is a multi-target receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor that has significant inhibitory activity against angiogenesis related kinases such as VEGFR1/2/3, FGFR1/2/3

coder_notes: Glioblastoma/GBM is mentioned only in the detailed description (VEGF rationale); conditions, title, inclusion criteria and arm label say only 'recurrent high-grade glioma' -> high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclude, not_glioblastoma) per C7/D27B.
